content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
Key Topics: Efficacy and safety of dofetilide in atrial fibrillation
Amiodarone versus placebo for atrial fibrillation
General Findings: Dofetilide is effective for converting and maintaining sinus rhythm in atrial fibrillation/flutter.
Amiodarone is compared for efficacy in clinical outcomes regarding mortality and morbidity.
Feasibility and safety in loading doses of drugs for atrial fibrillation management are discussed.
